title.en: Terrain contours linked to a height field

summary: Connect equal-elevation contour lines with horizontal slices through a labeled synthetic terrain.
objective: Make a synthetic terrain with selectable elevation contours, a horizontal slice plane and a linked map view.
intent_signals: Make a synthetic terrain with selectable elevation contours, a horizontal slice plane and a linked map view.
Connect equal-elevation contour lines with horizontal slices through a labeled synthetic terrain.
example_prompts: Make a synthetic terrain with selectable elevation contours, a horizontal slice plane and a linked map view.
Create an explorable 3D explanation of topographic contour map with map and slice.
negative_signals: Synthetic terrain is not a DEM, surveyed map or navigation product.
not_for: Synthetic terrain is not a DEM, surveyed map or navigation product.

entities.name: Terrain block
entities.guidance: Build a regular triangulated height mesh with a cut side wall and a visible horizontal scale; avoid implying a geographic location for invented heights.

entities.name: Contour curves
entities.guidance: Extract level sets from grid cells with a consistent saddle-cell rule; retain separate connected components and identify the selected elevation.

entities.name: Map and slice
entities.guidance: Link a top-down contour map to a horizontal slicing plane and numeric elevation probe; show contour interval and vertical exaggeration factor.

state_contract.model: For x,y in [-500,500] measured in meters, use synthetic height h=120*exp(-((x+150)^2+y^2)/40000)+80*exp(-((x-180)^2+(y-100)^2)/22500) meters. Extract fixed-increment contours from the same sampled height field.
state_contract.authority: The height field, horizontal coordinates and contour levels own geometry and labels; vertical exaggeration is a separate display transform.
actions: Select a contour elevation or move the horizontal slice.
Inspect a point and reset view settings.

invariants: Every contour point approximates its labeled elevation within the extraction tolerance.
Changing display exaggeration changes no source elevations or map distances.
Contour interval uses one elevation unit and stays constant within a layer.
motion_guidance: Slice-plane motion is an inspection control; hills are not uplifted or eroded by moving it.
Recompute extracted lines when the source height field changes, not by simply raising old curves.
known_limits: Synthetic terrain is not a DEM, surveyed map or navigation product.
Contour extraction resolution limits small features; projection, datum and geographic provenance must be supplied before using real data.
Curated recipe only; no runtime scene or rendered behavior has been verified for this record.

claims.statement: Topographic contour lines join positions of equal elevation.
claims.scope: Basic contour meaning; the recipe terrain and extraction method are independently authored.

source_refs.locator: Opening explanation of contour lines and equal elevation

object_craft.structure: Build a regular triangulated height mesh with a cut side wall and a visible horizontal scale; avoid implying a geographic location for invented heights.
object_craft.material: Matte terrain with restrained elevation tint and high-contrast thin contour lines; labels and side-wall scale prevent color-only elevation reading.
